title: Pishon the camel driver
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yevamot 107b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.107b.8), Beit Hillel said to Beit Shammai, “Did not Pishon the camel driver’s wife refuse the marriage in his absence?”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Miyun is the refusal of a marriage by a minor girl whose marriage was arranged for her.
The linked Bavli has HaGamal, “camel driver,” and says that his wife refused the marriage in his absence. Beit Shammai reply by invoking the way Pishon himself measured.

[Hyman’s printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=177) gives Yevamot 107b (קז:) and HaGamal. The supplied Hebrew reads 106b (קו:).
